data.output:
{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:
#   --partition=prod
#   --job-name=XXXXXX
#   --time=12:00:00
#   --ntasks-per-node=24
#   -o XXXXXX.out

flux alloc \
  -n 24 \
  --time=12h \
  --queue=prod \
  bash -lc '

# Approximate Slurm -o
exec >"XXXXXX.out" 2>&1

# NOTE: Slurm --ntasks-per-node=24 cannot be expressed portably in Flux here (node count not specified).
# Performance implication: tasks may be spread across multiple nodes depending on scheduler defaults,
# which can change MPI performance. If you require a single node, add -N 1.

# NOTE: Slurm --job-name=XXXXXX is not expressed here as a portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

module load openmpi
module load gromacs/5.1.4-single

# Keep mpirun as in the original script.
# Performance implication: MPI launch integration is site-specific under Flux; if mpirun is not integrated,
# ranks may not map to allocated resources as intended.
mpirun gmx_mpi mdrun -deffnm XXXXXX
'
"
}
